candidate: Tongji University Siping East Campus — A-building Data-Centre Fit-out

selected_geometry.precision: Representative point inside the community-mapped Tongji University East Campus. It locates the parent campus for the A-building room works, not Building A, a machine-room footprint, an entrance, construction boundary or official surveyed parcel.
selected_geometry.identity_review: The September22 original university tender explicitly names Tongji East Campus Building A at1230 Siping Road. The official gate directory identifies1230 Siping Road as the East Campus main entrance and separately identifies1239 Siping Road as the main Siping campus entrance. Native OSM way871639330 bears the exact East Campus name. The selected point is derived from that named campus polygon, rather than from the purchaser’s1239 address. The older Siping centre’s room location remains unknown; its historical operation is not assigned to this2026 works project. No building alias or map boundary is asserted to be an official parcel.
selected_geometry.uncertainty_reason: OSM gives no measured horizontal accuracy or verified displacement to Building A or its first-floor room; source precision is not survey precision.

point_method: Midpoint of native WGS84 vertex longitude/latitude extrema calculated with Decimal and verified inside the polygon by ray casting. No imagery tracing, GCJ/BD conversion or georeferencing.
location_observation: September22,2026 original university project address; historicalJanuary2025 entrance directory identifies East Campus separately from main Siping campus.
rights: OpenStreetMap contributors / ODbL-1.0. Government/university originals remain ignored and are not redistributed.
